title: Qman DirectPath portable operation envelope
x-qmanInteroperableIntegerRange: Every JSON numeric integer is in -9007199254740991..9007199254740991 before canonicalization; wider values use schema-defined decimal strings.
description: Closed common request/result envelope for exactly the 35 frozen backend-neutral OP-* operations. Operation-specific payload bytes are validated separately and are bound here by schema authority, schema reference, schema digest, and canonical payload digest.

timestamp.$comment: TIMESTAMP-UTC-US-V1: UTC RFC 3339 with exactly six fractional digits and literal Z; offsets, missing/variable fractions, and leap-second spelling are rejected.

schemaRef.$comment: Canonical repository-relative POSIX path plus an optional restricted JSON Pointer fragment. Absolute paths, backslashes, URI aliases, empty segments, query strings, and dot traversal are not legal.

hostEpochs.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [id,generation]; duplicate id values are rejected even when generations differ

runGenerations.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [id,generation]; duplicate id values are rejected even when generations differ

memberGenerations.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [id,generation]; id is deviceUid and duplicate id values are rejected

resourceVersions.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [entityType,resourceId,expectedResourceVersion]; duplicate [entityType,resourceId] keys are rejected

memberGenerations.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [id,generation]; id is deviceUid and duplicate id values are rejected

leaseBindings.x-qmanCanonicalOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [bundleId,leaseId,leaseVersion]; duplicate leaseId or bundleId is rejected

releaseOwnershipGuardCapability.x-qmanScopeRule: leaseBindings covers exactly bundleIds and hashes to leaseSetHash; operationLeaseId names the same live RELEASE capability; run/bundle/member/host/run/controller generations and backend profile exactly equal the original assignment authority. ACTIVE is the only authorizing state.

details.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [key,valueType,value]; duplicate key values are rejected

authoritativeStates.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [stateMachineId,aggregateId,state,resourceVersion,generation]; duplicate [stateMachineId,aggregateId] keys are rejected

committedResourceVersions.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [entityType,resourceId,committedResourceVersion]; duplicate [entityType,resourceId] keys are rejected

receiptHashes.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [receiptType,receiptId,schemaRef,receiptSha256]; duplicate [receiptType,receiptId] keys are rejected

x-qmanDetachedPayloadRule: The payload is not an open member of this envelope. Before use, fetch exact payload bytes from the operation transport, require payloadSchemaAuthority=PORTABLE_CONTRACT, select the unique operationId+envelopeKind fragment through requestPayloadSchemaBinding/resultPayloadSchemaBinding, verify payloadSchemaSha256 against the normative operation-payload schema raw hash, validate the closed payload, canonicalize with CANONICAL-JSON-V1 and require payloadHash equality. A target-local schema, alias, redirect, mutable latest reference, unknown field, direction/profile mismatch or hash mismatch fails closed.
x-qmanHashRules: requestHash is SHA-256 of CANONICAL-JSON-V1 over the complete REQUEST object with requestHash conceptually replaced by null; the transmitted REQUEST must carry a non-null requestHash
resultHash is SHA-256 of CANONICAL-JSON-V1 over the complete RESULT object with resultHash conceptually replaced by null; the transmitted RESULT must carry a non-null resultHash
The idempotency record binds [operationId,idempotencyScopeHash,idempotencyKey,requestHash]; a repeated key with a different requestHash returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED and never starts a second run

Every digest is lowercase sha256:<64 hex>; strings are NFC, integers are exact, floats are forbidden, and every x-qmanSetOrder array must arrive deduplicated and already sorted rather than being normalized after receipt
x-qmanCrossFieldRules: Exactly one of REQUEST or RESULT validates; envelopeKind is the discriminator and unknown top-level or nested fields are rejected
operationId, actorPortId, and idempotencyMode must match one of the 35 frozen operationIdentity tuples; no extension OP-* is accepted without a new version of this schema and portable contract
targetRepositoryObjectFormat determines the exact lowercase targetRepositoryCommit length: SHA1 is 40 hex and SHA256 is 64 hex
deadlineAt is strictly after issuedAt; completedAt is no later than the corresponding request deadline unless the operation returns a separately defined timeout result

For REQUEST, idempotencyKey is null only for OP-QUERY-DIRECTPATH and is mandatory for every other operation; RESULT echoes the byte-equal request operationId, commandId, idempotencyMode, idempotencyKey, and idempotencyScopeHash
authority host/run/member/resource arrays reject duplicate logical keys even when the remaining values differ; all supplied generations and expected versions are one coherent CAS read set

When operationLeaseCapabilityOrNull is non-null, its holderControllerGeneration equals authority.controllerGeneration, its member generations and host epoch are present identically in authority, and the live ENTITY-OPERATION-LEASE row must match every field including admissionBindingHashOrNull before the first covered side effect

Every detached payload operationLeaseBinding or releaseOperationLeaseBinding is an exact projection of the enclosing operationLeaseCapabilityOrNull for operationLeaseId, leaseType, scopeHash, holderControllerGeneration, operationLeaseResourceVersion, and admissionBindingHashOrNull; ASSIGNMENT_PREPARE requires the immutable admission binding hash and every other current lease type requires null

The schema requires a non-null typed operation capability for every frozen workflow/host/backend/process/release side-effect operation; transitionExecutionBinding.requiredLeaseTypeOrNull further selects the exact legal type in context. A wrong, stale, absent, consumed, revoked, or scope-mismatched capability fails before side effects

When releaseOwnershipGuardCapabilityOrNull is required, it names the same RELEASE operation lease, complete live lease/version/bundle/member set, run, epochs/generations, process-or-never-created proof, backend profile and controller generation as the request and repository. Null, inactive, partial or mismatched guard authority fails before stop/teardown/release/clean-release side effects

A RESULT with IN_PROGRESS or SUCCEEDED has reason null and retryable false; REJECTED, CONFLICT, or FAILED has one non-null frozen reason; retryable is true only for INVENTORY_EPOCH_CHANGED, STALE_RESOURCE_VERSION, STALE_CONTROLLER_GENERATION, or DEPENDENCY_BUSY
reason code and stage are a closed frozen pair; devices, details, and provenance are explicit possibly-empty canonical sets and duplicate logical keys are rejected
authoritativeStates accepts only a state from the named frozen FSM and has at most one row per [stateMachineId,aggregateId]

committedResourceVersions has at most one row per [entityType,resourceId]; a create has previousResourceVersionOrNull null and committedResourceVersion 1, otherwise committedResourceVersion equals previousResourceVersionOrNull plus one
receiptHashes identifies each receipt by a closed schema reference and exact schema/document hashes; a digest without its receipt type, identity, and schema binding is not authoritative

Every RESULT portable contract hash, target commit, operation tuple, command identity and correlation identity exactly equals the accepted REQUEST. payloadSchemaAuthority, payloadSchemaSha256 and payloadCanonicalProfile remain request-equal, while payloadSchemaRef changes only from the operation's unique REQUEST profile fragment to its unique RESULT profile fragment; payloadHash independently binds the detached result payload.
x-qmanCaptureHostSnapshotEnvelopeRules: OP-CAPTURE-HOST-SNAPSHOT carries null operationLeaseCapabilityOrNull and null releaseOwnershipGuardCapabilityOrNull. correlation has hostIds exactly [requestPayload.body.hostId], deviceUids empty because device identities are not accepted until capture verification, assignmentIdOrNull/runIdOrNull/relocationIdOrNull null, and the complete correlation object is byte-equal in REQUEST and RESULT

Its authority snapshotEpoch is the exact current HostSnapshot epoch or null for genesis; hostEpochs is exactly one [hostId,hostEpoch] from requestPayload.body.hostBootIdentity; runGenerations and memberGenerations are empty; resourceVersions is the canonical closed set of current HostAuthority, AvailabilityAuthority, CapabilityPolicyAuthority, and HostSnapshotFreshnessPolicyAuthority expectations. controllerGeneration comes from an independently current controller authority, not from caller payload bytes

A component verifier may establish the request/payload/hash/read-set projection but cannot attest transport authentication, controller-generation currentness, idempotency ownership, repository acceptance, or deadline enforcement without product receipts

For a SUCCEEDED result, authority is the resolved post-decision projection, not an echo of the request CAS read set: controllerGeneration and the singleton hostEpochs exact-equal the request, snapshotEpoch exact-equals hostSnapshotAfter.snapshotEpoch, runGenerations/memberGenerations remain empty, and resourceVersions is the sorted closed four-authority set selecting after HostAuthority/AvailabilityAuthority versions for COMMITTED and byte-identical current versions for NO_CHANGE while retaining the current capability/freshness policy authority versions.

For SUCCEEDED COMMITTED, authoritativeStates is empty and committedResourceVersions is exactly the sorted HostAuthority and AvailabilityAuthority before/after pair. receiptHashes is exactly five rows: RECEIPT-HOST-SNAPSHOT-ROLLBACK-PREFLIGHT over the retained rollbackAuthorityPreflightReceipt bytes, RECEIPT-HOST-SNAPSHOT-ANCHOR-PREPARE over the retained prepareReceipt bytes, RECEIPT-HOST-SNAPSHOT-ANCHOR-COMMIT over the finalized anchor receipt bytes, RECEIPT-HOST-SNAPSHOT-ANCHOR-FRESHNESS over the after-freshness state bytes, and RECEIPT-HOST-SNAPSHOT-REPOSITORY-COMMIT over the durable repositoryCommitRecord bytes. For SUCCEEDED NO_CHANGE, authoritativeStates and committedResourceVersions are empty and receiptHashes is exactly the preflight, finalized-anchor-receipt and after-freshness rows; prepare and repository-commit rows are forbidden. Each schemaSha256 hashes the exact loaded schema document bytes and each receiptSha256 hashes the exact canonical receipt/state bytes. Result envelope/payload/context bytes and hashes, whole trace hashes, and caller-selected extra labels are forbidden from this set.
